name: CLUB
description: CLUB (Chemical Language Understanding Benchmark) is a set of four datasets designed for chemical language understanding tasks including text and token classification, sourced from patent and literature articles in the chemical industry.
reputation: A specialized chemistry NLP benchmark that is cited in the chemical language understanding literature, but it is still relatively niche compared with mainstream NLP benchmarks.
notes: Datasets created internally by chemists; baseline average accuracy reported as 0.8054.
